model_fragment_what_this_is: q4km-mmproj-free-speech-native-np8-base-speech-query-prefix-max64 with -np 8 replaced by -np 4 and nothing else: the same GGUF, the same featcache build, the same packet root and decoder hash, the same batch and cache flags, the same prompt order, and byte-identical decoding_params (greedy, temperature 0, seed 20260803, max_tokens 64, per-sample slot affinity).
model_fragment_why_four_slots: Per-slot context, not throughput. The KC-S1b slot-stage cell appends a per-sample TRAIN slot-schema block to its phase instruction, and the FALLBACK block a row gets when the sealed closed-list prediction does not parse or names a (scenario, action) pair TRAIN never carries is the FULL 60-intent schema: 26,720 characters, about 7,500 tokens, on top of a 7,583-character system message. At -np 8 the 65,536-token server context divides into 8,192-token slots and such a row does not fit; at -np 4 it divides into 16,384 and it fits with roughly 6,000 tokens to spare. Concurrency is not a request-content variable (2026-09-05 closed-list verdict, deviation 2): the request bytes, the decoding parameters and the packet are unchanged, only how many of them are in flight at once. KC-S1a flies the SAME geometry so the (S1b minus S1a) contrast is geometry-matched.
model_fragment_cost_of_the_choice: Halved slot occupancy. The sealed closed-list arm ran 1,000 contacts in 225.5 s at -np 8; the same roster at -np 4 is expected around 450 s. That is inside every budget cell of the KC-S1 cells and buys a prompt-fit margin no compaction pass would have to eat into.
